mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 200-day moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% annually, supply chain bottlenecks and inflationary pressures intensify, leading to reduced corporate profit margins and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) signals robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate investment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 95 for 2 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
